audit_report.title: Heiwa House Admin UI/UX Audit Feedback

issues: Many forms rely on minimal spacing (space-y classes) without grouping related fields
Required fields are not clearly indicated
Inputs lack consistent styling (e.g., plain date fields, default HTML color pickers)
Buttons are often cramped at the bottom without proper DialogFooter styling
forms_modals.impact: Causes cluttered, confusing layouts and makes it hard to scan sections and identify required inputs

issues: Uses basic <input type='color'> for event colour
Plain date inputs with no calendar picker
Fields are stacked with little separation
Calendar appears inside the modal, leading to cramped layout
create_event_modal.impact: Poor visual hierarchy and an unprofessional feel. Colour picker is hard to use; date fields are confusing without a picker

issues: Almost no spacing between fields
Plain inputs for dates and currency
Labels are sometimes missing or unclear
No grouping of related fields
invoices_payments_modals.impact: Users may not know what to enter or may miss important information. Lack of grouping and spacing reduces usability

issues: Add Client button appears disabled and cannot be used (link leads to 404)
Table rows have minimal spacing
No way to view details when clicking the row or eye icon (link is broken)
clients_bookings_tables.impact: Missing functionality prevents adding or viewing clients; inconsistent spacing makes tables hard to read

issues: Date filters are basic input fields with placeholders but no date-picker
No visual grouping between filter controls and metrics
dashboard_analytics.impact: Could be improved with date-picker controls and clearer separation of control and metric areas

issues: Section cards use small checkboxes for 'Active'
Little spacing between controls
Add Section dialog truncates section names due to narrow card widths
cms_page_editor.impact: Section names are difficult to read; small toggles may hinder accessibility. Users may struggle to choose the correct section type

issues: Relies on a long vertical scroll
Field grouping is minimal
Required fields are not obvious
hero_section_editor.impact: Editing long sections becomes tedious; users may overlook required fields

issues.description: Uses the default <input type='color'> for event colour, resulting in an unstyled colour picker
issues.current_implementation: Colour field shows a basic browser colour picker
issues.recommended_fix: Replace with a custom colour picker component that shows colour swatches and a hex input
issues.impact: Improves aesthetics and usability; matches brand colours

issues.description: Start/End date fields are plain text inputs without calendar icons or date-picker. Calendar component appears inside the modal, making the layout very crowded
issues.current_implementation: Date inputs use mm/dd/yyyy placeholders; no calendar icon; the calendar sits between fields
issues.recommended_fix: Use a proper date-picker component with an icon and an external calendar; group date fields with a heading such as 'Event dates'
issues.impact: Simplifies selecting dates and improves visual hierarchy

issues.description: There is no clear separation between the Title, Description, Dates, Event Type, Colour and Location fields. Everything is stacked with minimal spacing
issues.current_implementation: Single vertical column of inputs; fields appear cramped
issues.recommended_fix: Wrap related fields in bordered sections or use subtle background colours (e.g., bg-gray-50/50) and headings (e.g., 'Event Details,' 'Scheduling')
issues.impact: Helps users scan sections quickly

issues.description: 'Cancel' and 'Create Event' buttons are adjacent without extra padding or section break
issues.current_implementation: Buttons are at the bottom with little spacing
issues.recommended_fix: Place buttons inside a DialogFooter with top border and gap-2 spacing; ensure the primary button stands out
issues.impact: Prevents accidental clicks and improves hierarchy

issues.description: Fields in the 'Record Payment' modal have no labels and inconsistent styling; Payment Method dropdown is hidden until user scrolls; date and currency fields are plain inputs with no icons
issues.current_implementation: Booking ID and Amount fields appear without labels; currency dropdown is small; date input uses mm/dd/yyyy placeholder
issues.recommended_fix: Add labels above each input; integrate a date-picker with calendar icon; provide a custom select component for currency and payment method; group related fields
issues.impact: Improves clarity and prevents input errors

issues.description: Inputs are stacked directly on top of each other with almost no space
issues.current_implementation: The modal shows fields crammed together; 'Transaction ID' and 'Payment Date' fields overlap
issues.recommended_fix: Increase vertical spacing (space-y-4 within a section) and separate groups (e.g., Payment Info vs. Notes)
issues.impact: Enhances readability and reduces cognitive load

issues.description: The 'Cancel' and 'Record Payment' buttons lack a footer or border; they are flush against inputs
issues.current_implementation: Buttons are not separated from form content
issues.recommended_fix: Use a DialogFooter component with padding, and make the primary button visually prominent
issues.impact: Distinguishes actions clearly

issues.description: Fields have no clear labels; Booking ID and Amount inputs are adjacent with no spacing; date inputs have no calendar picker
issues.current_implementation: The modal shows a long input for Booking ID, followed by Amount, currency, due date, and status all in one compressed area
issues.recommended_fix: Add labels and group fields (Booking details vs Invoice details); use a date-picker with icon; clearly mark required fields
issues.impact: Reduces confusion and aids data entry

issues.description: Status drop-down uses default select styling; colours for statuses are absent
issues.current_implementation: Default HTML select element appears inside the modal
issues.recommended_fix: Use custom select components with consistent styling and apply colour tags for statuses (e.g., green for paid, yellow for pending)
issues.impact: Improves visual consistency and recognition

issues.description: There are no loading states for the 'Create Invoice' button; user receives no feedback during submission
issues.current_implementation: The button shows static text even when clicked
issues.recommended_fix: Add a loading spinner or change button text to 'Creating…' when performing asynchronous operations
issues.impact: Enhances user feedback

issues.description: The row 'eye' icon and booking ID link do not open any details; clicking them does nothing
issues.current_implementation: On the Bookings table, the eye icon fails to trigger any action and there's no way to view bookings
issues.recommended_fix: Implement click handlers to open a booking details modal or page; ensure keyboard accessibility
issues.impact: Prevents frustration and ensures core functionality

issues.description: Table columns (Booking ID, Guest, Type, Dates, Amount, Status) are fixed and will overflow on smaller screens; filters and date inputs are inline and may not wrap nicely
issues.current_implementation: On large screens the table appears fine; on smaller screens it likely requires horizontal scrolling
issues.recommended_fix: Use a responsive table pattern (stack columns or provide collapsible details) and ensure the filter section wraps
issues.impact: Improves usability on tablets and mobile

issues.description: Date filters are plain inputs with mm/dd/yyyy placeholder and calendar icons, but clicking the icon does nothing
issues.current_implementation: Filter section uses two date inputs with small icons
issues.recommended_fix: Integrate actual date-picker components with a calendar pop-up; show clear placeholder text like 'Start date'
issues.impact: Helps users choose dates correctly

issues.description: 'Add Client' button appears but is not functional; the URL /admin/clients/new returns a 404 page
issues.current_implementation: Top-right 'Add Client' link leads to a 404 error
issues.recommended_fix: Implement the client creation page or hide the button until implemented
issues.impact: Prevents user confusion and incomplete tasks

issues.description: Clicking the eye icon in each row does not open client details; the link is broken
issues.current_implementation: Eye icon in 'Actions' column does nothing when clicked
issues.recommended_fix: Fix or implement the client detail modal/page
issues.impact: Allows admins to view and edit client information

issues.description: Table rows are tightly packed; there is minimal padding
issues.current_implementation: Each row uses default table styling with little vertical spacing
issues.recommended_fix: Increase table row padding (py-3 or py-4); add zebra striping for readability
issues.impact: Enhances legibility

issues.description: Fields are grouped only by space-y-4; there are no visual dividers between Room Information, Amenities and Images sections
issues.current_implementation: The form appears as one long list of inputs and checkboxes
issues.recommended_fix: Add section headers (e.g., 'Room Details,' 'Pricing,' 'Amenities,' 'Images') with borders or background colours; wrap each section in a div with border, rounded-lg, p-4 and space-y-4
issues.impact: Makes the form easier to scan and reduces cognitive load

issues.description: Amenities checkboxes are plain and not grouped; colour pickers are absent
issues.current_implementation: Amenities are displayed as a grid of basic checkboxes
issues.recommended_fix: Use custom checkboxes with icons and labels; group them under a heading
issues.impact: Improves usability and ensures consistency

issues.description: Featured image and additional images use drag-and-drop, which is good; however, there is no preview or validation
issues.current_implementation: The upload area shows an icon and text but no preview
issues.recommended_fix: Show thumbnails of uploaded images and enforce file type/size validation; indicate the recommended dimensions
issues.impact: Enhances feedback

issues.description: Filters for Start Date, End Date and Brand are plain inputs; there are no date-pickers or clear guidelines
issues.current_implementation: Filter bar uses mm/dd/yyyy inputs with small icons; clicking the icon does not open a calendar
issues.recommended_fix: Use date-picker components with icons; clearly separate filters from metrics using a border or a card header
issues.impact: Improves data selection and emphasises filter controls

issues.description: Bar charts and stats use good colour contrast, but there is no legend or tooltips explaining the data
issues.current_implementation: The Monthly Revenue and Booking Trends charts show coloured bars without labels
issues.recommended_fix: Add simple legends or tooltips; allow hover to reveal exact values
issues.impact: Improves data understanding

cms_page_editor.location: CMS > Flow Page Editor & Add Section Modal

issues.description: Section cards have minimal spacing and small active toggles; there is no clear separation between sections
issues.current_implementation: The content-section list uses only light borders; toggles are small checkboxes
issues.recommended_fix: Increase spacing between section cards, use a border-t or shadow for each card, and replace small checkboxes with larger toggles or switches
issues.impact: Improves readability and makes toggling easier

issues.description: The Add Section modal displays numerous section types in small cards; names are truncated (e.g., 'Text Sectio n') due to narrow widths
issues.current_implementation: Section names break mid-word; cards have limited width
issues.recommended_fix: Use a two-column grid with responsive breakpoints; allow section names to wrap properly or increase card width; add tooltips or previews
issues.impact: Helps users choose the right section

issues.description: The 'Active' checkbox on each section is small and not labelled; keyboard navigation may be difficult
issues.current_implementation: Only a small checkmark indicates active state; there is no label
issues.recommended_fix: Replace checkboxes with labelled toggle switches; ensure the label is associated with the control
issues.impact: Improves accessibility and usability

issues.description: The Edit Hero Section modal is long and requires scrolling; there is little grouping of related fields and no clear indication of required fields
issues.current_implementation: Fields for title, subtitle, description, button text, link and background image are stacked
issues.recommended_fix: Divide the modal into subsections with headings ('Text Content,' 'Button,' 'Background Image'), mark required fields with an asterisk and use scrollable panels when necessary
issues.impact: Enhances editing flow

navigation_authentication.issue: The admin login page prompts for a password but the site is accessible without entering it. Clicking 'Log Out' returns to login but still shows the admin pages
navigation_authentication.impact: This behaviour may be a security issue. A proper authentication flow with session handling and password verification is needed

broken_links.issue: Many admin actions (viewing clients, bookings, or rooms) lead to 404 pages or client-side errors
broken_links.impact: Broken links degrade trust and make the admin unusable
examples: Eye icon links in tables are broken

loading_states.issue: Across modals and forms there are no loading or disabled states while asynchronous actions occur
loading_states.impact: Users don't know if their action is being processed
loading_states.recommended_fix: Adding spinners or button text changes ('Saving…') would provide feedback

responsive_design.issue: Most pages were tested on a desktop viewport; there is no evidence of responsive tables or modal resizing
responsive_design.impact: Admin pages may be unusable on tablets and mobile devices
responsive_design.recommended_fix: Admin pages should be tested on smaller screens and provide responsive layouts (stacked filters, collapsible sections, etc.)

critical: Fix broken links (Add Client, view details, booking details)
Implement proper authentication flow with session handling
Replace all basic HTML color inputs with custom color pickers
high: Add visual grouping to all forms (bordered sections, headers)
Replace plain date inputs with date-picker components
Add proper spacing between form fields and sections
Implement loading states for all async actions
Fix table row spacing and add proper padding
Add labels to all form inputs
Use DialogFooter for all modal buttons
Test and fix responsive design issues
medium: Add status color tags to selects
Improve section card spacing in CMS editor
Fix truncated section names in Add Section modal
Replace small checkboxes with toggle switches
Add image previews to file uploads
Add legends and tooltips to charts

conclusion.summary: The Heiwa House admin dashboard offers a functional skeleton but suffers from major UI/UX shortcomings: broken links, cramped forms and modals, basic input elements (especially date and colour fields), inconsistent spacing and lack of visual hierarchy
recommendations: Replace default inputs with custom components
Group related fields into clearly defined sections
Add proper date-picker and colour-picker controls
Enhance accessibility with labelled toggle switches, larger touch targets and proper focus management
conclusion.expected_outcome: Addressing these issues will make the admin dashboard more professional, usable and accessible
